limitations: B0 values are transcribed from the 28 benchmark-result screenshots present in the Home archive.
The other 16 registered datasets have preparation material but no benchmark-result screenshot in the archive.
The screenshots report mean and P99 latency, not P95; this publication uses only the explicitly reported mean latency fields.
The 2026-10-03 candidate audit populated 12 B1 cells from vSpec raw artifacts; remaining B1 cells require matching measured evidence.
The Qwen3.5 BidKV EvoScientist result uses a different model and TP4 configuration, so it is published through a separate model scenario.
